rows.name: Marketing Manager
rows.jobDuty:
Responsibilities

Brand Marketing & Brand Equity Building

Lead brand marketing initiatives for the Keemart business. Develop and execute brand communication strategies centered on brand positioning, core values, and long-term vision, continuously strengthening brand equity, user trust, and brand preference.

Brand Content & Social Media Management

Own the content strategy and day-to-day operations of official social media channels. Build a clear and consistent brand tone, and drive brand visibility, favorability, and engagement through high-quality content, topic planning, and interactive community initiatives.

Integrated Brand Communication & Project Management

Plan and deliver brand-led integrated marketing communication projects, covering social media campaigns, content distribution, community touchpoints, and online-offline coordination, ensuring consistent brand messaging and impact across all consumer touchpoints.

CSR & Community Engagement Programs

Lead or actively participate in the planning and execution of Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and community programs. Establish partnerships with local NGOs, community organizations, and relevant government or social institutions to deliver initiatives that generate real social impact while reinforcing brand purpose and reputation.

Cross-functional Brand Collaboration

Work closely with user growth, digital marketing, product, and operations teams to ensure brand strategy is consistently embedded across product experience, communication content, and user touchpoints, aligning brand objectives with business goals.
rows.jobRequirement:
Requirements

Brand & Marketing Experience

8+ years of marketing experience, preferably with international or regional brands. Experience in e-commerce, instant retail, FMCG, or new consumer brands is highly preferred, with proven involvement in systematic brand projects or brand-building initiatives.

Brand Thinking & Content Capability

Strong brand-led marketing mindset, with the ability to design communication strategies from brand positioning and consumer mindset perspectives. Demonstrated success in brand content, social media operations, or integrated communication campaigns, supported by clear methodologies and case examples.

CSR / Social Impact Experience

Understanding of and interest in CSR or social impact initiatives. Prior experience in planning, executing, or partnering on CSR or community projects is a plus, with the ability to connect long-term brand value with meaningful social contribution.

Data Awareness & Brand Performance Evaluation

Data-driven mindset with the ability to assess brand and communication performance through relevant brand metrics, and continuously optimize brand and content strategies based on data, insights, and business feedback.

Cross-cultural & International Exposure

Experience working in cross-cultural or cross-border environments, with the ability to operate effectively in diverse markets and deliver locally relevant brand communication.

Language Skills

English is required as a working language. Proficiency in Arabic or prior experience in Middle East markets is a strong advantage.

rows.name: 仓库培训专员
rows.jobDuty:
一、培训体系搭建与规划
结合仓库作业流程、岗位标准、安全规范，制定年度/月度培训计划，明确培训内容、课时、参训人员及考核目标。梳理各岗位SOP、操作手册、安全制度，搭建仓库分层培训体系（新员工、在岗员工、班组长、专项技能）。跟进业务变化，及时更新培训课件、教材、视频、试题等培训资料。
二、新员工入职培训
负责仓库新人全流程入职培训：企业文化、园区/仓库规章制度、考勤、行为规范，开展基础作业培训：库区划分、货物识别、出入库流程、扫码/系统操作、劳保用品使用。安排师徒带教，跟踪新人在岗实操学习，定期复盘学习进度，确保快速上岗。
三、在岗员工常态化培训
组织日常技能复训、流程宣贯、制度解读，提升全员作业熟练度与规范性。开展专项培训：盘点作业、分拣/打包/装卸、货位管理、异常处理、6S管理等。落地安全培训：消防安全、叉车/地牛等设备操作、危化品管理、人车分流、应急演练。针对低效、出错、违规问题开展定向纠偏培训，降低作业差错率。
四、培训实施与现场管理
独立组织线下授课、实操演练、现场带教、案例分享、情景模拟等各类培训。协调培训场地、教具、设备、讲师，障培训正常开展。维护培训秩序，记录培训考勤、课堂表现、现场问题并及时整改。
五、考核、复盘与数据统计
组织理论笔试、实操考核，判定培训效果，出具考核结果，对不合格人员安排复训。统计培训数据：参训人数、完成率、合格率、培训时长，形成培训报表。培训后回访调研，收集员工、主管反馈，持续优化培训方式与内容。
六、讲师与团队管理
选拔、培养内部兼职讲师（仓管、组长、老员工），制定讲师管理与激励规则。指导兼职讲师授课方法、课件使用，提升整体授课质量。
七、合规、档案与其他工作
建立完整培训档案：参训记录、考核成绩、培训课件、签到表、影像资料，做到可追溯。配合仓库完成质检、迎审、专项整改类培训工作。完成上级交办的其他临时培训相关任务。

1. Training System Development and Planning  
Develop annual and monthly training plans based on warehouse operations, job standards, and safety regulations, clearly defining training content, class hours, participants, and assessment objectives. Organize SOPs, operation manuals, and safety policies for each position to establish a tiered warehouse training system (new hires, current employees, team leaders, and specialized skills). Continuously update training materials—including courseware, textbooks, videos, and test questions—in response to business changes.

2. New Employee Onboarding Training  
Lead end-to-end onboarding training for new warehouse staff, covering company culture, site/warehouse rules and regulations, attendance policies, and behavioral standards. Deliver foundational operational training including warehouse area layout, product identification, inbound/outbound processes, scanning/system operations, and personal protective equipment usage. Assign mentorship programs, monitor hands-on learning progress, conduct regular reviews, and ensure rapid job readiness.

3. Ongoing Training for In-Service Employees  
Organize routine skill refreshers, process communications, and policy explanations to enhance overall operational proficiency and compliance. Conduct specialized training in areas such as inventory counting, sorting/packaging/loading/unloading, storage slot management, exception handling, and 6S management. Implement safety training covering fire safety, forklift and pallet truck operation, hazardous material handling, pedestrian-vehicle separation, and emergency drills. Provide targeted corrective training for inefficiencies, errors, or violations to reduce operational mistakes.

4. Training Execution and On-Site Management  
Independently organize various training formats including classroom instruction, hands-on practice, on-site coaching, case studies, and scenario simulations. Coordinate training venues, teaching aids, equipment, and instructors to ensure smooth implementation. Maintain training discipline, record attendance, classroom performance, and on-site issues, and promptly address any concerns.

5. Assessment, Review, and Data Reporting  
Conduct theoretical written tests and practical assessments to evaluate training effectiveness, issue evaluation results, and arrange retraining for underperforming individuals. Collect and analyze training data—such as participant numbers, completion rates, pass rates, and training duration—and generate comprehensive training reports. Conduct post-training follow-up surveys to gather feedback from employees and supervisors, continuously improving training methods and content.

6. Trainer and Team Management  
Select and develop internal part-time trainers (warehouse staff, team leaders, experienced employees), establishing clear management and incentive guidelines. Guide part-time trainers on teaching methodologies and courseware utilization to improve overall training quality.

7. Compliance, Documentation, and Other Responsibilities  
Maintain complete training records including participation logs, assessment scores, training materials, sign-in sheets, and audiovisual documentation to ensure traceability. Support warehouse operations in quality inspections, audits, and special improvement initiatives through relevant training. Complete other temporary training-related tasks assigned by superiors.

rows.name: 无人车业务部-传感器系统工程师（激光雷达）

department.name: 软硬件服务-无人车业务部

rows.jobDuty:
负责自动驾驶车辆激光雷达子系统的系统集成、性能验证与持续优化工作。具体包括：
参与激光雷达传感器的选型评估与技术对标，从光学性能、点云质量、环境适应性、可靠性等维度建立评价体系，输出选型建议与技术对比报告。
主导激光雷达与车载计算平台的集成调试，包括通信链路打通（UDP点云数据、TCP控制协议）、PTP时间同步对齐、多雷达坐标系标定与外参管理等工作，确保数据链路端到端稳定可靠。
设计并执行激光雷达性能测试方案，覆盖探测距离、角分辨率、测距精度、反射率响应、高反滤波效果等关键指标，建立量化的性能基线与回归验证机制。
推动激光雷达在整车环境下的可靠性验证，包括振动、温湿度、电磁兼容等环境适应性测试，以及长时运行的功能稳定性监测。
与激光雷达供应商保持紧密协作，跟踪固件版本迭代、SDK升级与问题修复，管理各开发阶段的供应商交付物清单，推动技术问题闭环。
参与传感器数据质量自动化质检体系的建设，开发或优化数据解析、异常检测、质量报告生成等工具链，支撑批量车辆的传感器健康度监控。
协同感知算法团队，从传感器端理解算法对点云数据的需求，推动传感器参数调优与性能迭代，支持算法性能提升。
rows.jobRequirement:
本科及以上学历，电子工程、光学工程、自动化、测控技术等相关专业，3年以上激光雷达或车载传感器系统相关工作经验。
熟悉激光雷达（ToF或Flash LiDAR）的工作原理，理解扫描方式、光路设计、探测器特性等基础知识。
具备嵌入式系统或车载网络调试经验，熟悉以太网通信、UDP协议、CAN/CANFD总线，能独立完成传感器与计算平台之间的通信链路调试。
掌握 Python 或 C++ 编程，能编写数据解析、协议对接、自动化测试相关的工具脚本；有点云数据处理（PCL、Open3D等）经验者优先。
具备良好的问题分析与定位能力，能从现象出发系统性排查传感器软硬件问题，有良好的文档习惯和跨团队沟通能力。
rows.highLight: 提供软硬结合的稀缺成长路径：纵向上从硬件光学特性到协议解析和数据质量评价，横向上从供应商开发推进到算法侧需求对齐。同时基于公司优质的AI资源，打造传感器自动化分析体系，与团队共同探索AI时代下传感系统研发新模式。
